passages.text: Dishonest scales are an abomination to the LORD, but an accurate weight is His delight.
passages.sermon:
The LORD hates dishonest scales.
Dishonest scales are an abomination to Him.
The LORD delights in an accurate weight.
An accurate weight pleases Him.
passages.original: מֹאזְנֵ֣י מִ֭רְמָה תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְאֶ֖בֶן שְׁלֵמָ֣ה רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃

passages.text: When pride comes, disgrace follows, but with humility comes wisdom.
passages.sermon:
Pride enters a person’s heart.
Disgrace comes after pride.
A humble person receives wisdom.
Humility brings wisdom.
passages.original: בָּֽא־ זָ֭דוֹן וַיָּבֹ֣א קָל֑וֹן וְֽאֶת־ צְנוּעִ֥ים חָכְמָֽה׃

passages.text: The integrity of the upright guides them, but the perversity of the faithless destroys them.
passages.sermon:
The upright have integrity.
Integrity guides the upright.
The faithless act with perversity.
Perversity destroys the faithless.
passages.original: תֻּמַּ֣ת יְשָׁרִ֣ים תַּנְחֵ֑ם וְסֶ֖לֶף בּוֹגְדִ֣ים וְשַׁדָּם׃

passages.text: Riches are worthless in the day of wrath, but righteousness brings deliverance from death.
passages.sermon:
Riches cannot help on the day of God's anger.
Money has no value when God judges.
Righteousness saves from death.
Doing what is right delivers a person from destruction.
passages.original: לֹא־ יוֹעִ֣יל ה֭וֹן בְּי֣וֹם עֶבְרָ֑ה וּ֝צְדָקָ֗ה תַּצִּ֥יל מִמָּֽוֶת׃

passages.text: The righteousness of the blameless directs their path, but the wicked fall by their own wickedness.
passages.sermon:
The blameless person lives with righteousness.
Righteousness guides the blameless person’s path.
The wicked person acts with wickedness.
Wickedness causes the wicked person to fall.
passages.original: צִדְקַ֣ת תָּ֭מִים תְּיַשֵּׁ֣ר דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וּ֝בְרִשְׁעָת֗וֹ יִפֹּ֥ל רָשָֽׁע׃

passages.text: The righteousness of the upright delivers them, but the faithless are trapped by their own desires.
passages.sermon:
The upright person lives with righteousness.
Righteousness saves the upright person.
The faithless person acts with betrayal.
The faithless person becomes trapped by their own desires.
passages.original: צִדְקַ֣ת יְ֭שָׁרִים תַּצִּילֵ֑ם וּ֝בְהַוַּ֗ת בֹּגְדִ֥ים יִלָּכֵֽדוּ׃

passages.text: When the wicked man dies, his hope perishes, and the hope of his strength vanishes.
passages.sermon:
A wicked man trusts in his own strength.
He places his hope in his own power.
When this wicked man dies, his hope ends.
His strength cannot save him.
His hope disappears with his death.
passages.original: בְּמ֤וֹת אָדָ֣ם רָ֭שָׁע תֹּאבַ֣ד תִּקְוָ֑ה וְתוֹחֶ֖לֶת אוֹנִ֣ים אָבָֽדָה׃

passages.text: The righteous man is delivered from trouble; in his place the wicked man goes in.
passages.sermon: A righteous man escapes from trouble.\r\nA wicked man takes his place in that trouble.
passages.original: צַ֭דִּיק מִצָּרָ֣ה נֶחֱלָ֑ץ וַיָּבֹ֖א רָשָׁ֣ע תַּחְתָּֽיו׃

passages.text: With his mouth the ungodly man destroys his neighbor, but through knowledge the righteous are rescued.
passages.sermon:
The ungodly man speaks with his mouth.
He destroys his neighbor with his words.
The righteous have knowledge.
Their knowledge rescues them.
passages.original: בְּפֶ֗ה חָ֭נֵף יַשְׁחִ֣ת רֵעֵ֑הוּ וּ֝בְדַ֗עַת צַדִּיקִ֥ים יֵחָלֵֽצוּ׃

passages.text: When the righteous thrive, the city rejoices, and when the wicked perish, there are shouts of joy.
passages.sermon:
Righteous people do good.
The city becomes happy when righteous people succeed.
Wicked people do evil.
When wicked people die, people shout for joy.
passages.original: בְּט֣וּב צַ֭דִּיקִים תַּעֲלֹ֣ץ קִרְיָ֑ה וּבַאֲבֹ֖ד רְשָׁעִ֣ים רִנָּֽה׃

passages.text: By the blessing of the upright a city is built up, but by the mouth of the wicked it is torn down.
passages.sermon:
The upright are people who do what is right.
Their blessing builds up a city.
The wicked are people who do evil.
Their words tear down a city.
passages.original: בְּבִרְכַּ֣ת יְ֭שָׁרִים תָּר֣וּם קָ֑רֶת וּבְפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים תֵּהָרֵֽס׃

passages.text: Whoever shows contempt for his neighbor lacks judgment, but a man of understanding remains silent.
passages.sermon:
A person who shows contempt for his neighbor lacks judgment.
A person who despises his neighbor does not have wisdom.
A man of understanding remains silent.
A wise person does not speak in such situations.
passages.original: בָּז־ לְרֵעֵ֥הוּ חֲסַר־ לֵ֑ב וְאִ֖ישׁ תְּבוּנ֣וֹת יַחֲרִֽישׁ׃

passages.text: A gossip reveals a secret, but a trustworthy person keeps a confidence.
passages.sermon:
A gossip reveals secrets.
A gossip does not keep things private.
A trustworthy person keeps a confidence.
A trustworthy person does not share secrets.
passages.original: הוֹלֵ֣ךְ רָ֭כִיל מְגַלֶּה־ סּ֑וֹד וְנֶאֱמַן־ ר֝֗וּחַ מְכַסֶּ֥ה דָבָֽר׃

passages.text: For lack of guidance, a nation falls, but with many counselors comes deliverance.
passages.sermon:
A nation needs guidance.
If a nation lacks guidance, it will fall.
Many counselors give advice.
With many counselors, a nation finds deliverance.
passages.original: בְּאֵ֣ין תַּ֭חְבֻּלוֹת יִפָּל־ עָ֑ם וּ֝תְשׁוּעָ֗ה בְּרֹ֣ב יוֹעֵֽץ׃

passages.text: He who puts up security for a stranger will surely suffer, but the one who hates indebtedness is secure.
passages.sermon: A person who guarantees a loan for a stranger will suffer harm.\r\nA person who avoids making such guarantees remains safe.
passages.original: רַע־ יֵ֭רוֹעַ כִּי־ עָ֣רַב זָ֑ר וְשֹׂנֵ֖א תֹקְעִ֣ים בּוֹטֵֽחַ׃

passages.text: A gracious woman attains honor, but ruthless men gain only wealth.
passages.sermon:
A gracious woman receives honor.
She shows kindness and grace.
People respect her.
Ruthless men gain wealth.
They act harshly.
They do not receive honor.
They only get riches.
passages.original: אֵֽשֶׁת־ חֵ֭ן תִּתְמֹ֣ךְ כָּב֑וֹד וְ֝עָרִיצִ֗ים יִתְמְכוּ־ עֹֽשֶׁר׃

passages.text: A kind man benefits himself, but a cruel man brings trouble on himself.
passages.sermon:
A kind man helps himself.
A kind man does good to his own life.
A cruel man harms himself.
A cruel man brings trouble to his own life.
passages.original: גֹּמֵ֣ל נַ֭פְשׁוֹ אִ֣ישׁ חָ֑סֶד וְעֹכֵ֥ר שְׁ֝אֵר֗וֹ אַכְזָרִֽי׃

passages.text: The wicked man earns an empty wage, but he who sows righteousness reaps a true reward.
passages.sermon:
A wicked man acts with deceit.
He earns nothing of real value.
A righteous person does good.
He receives a true and lasting reward.
passages.original: רָשָׁ֗ע עֹשֶׂ֥ה פְעֻלַּת־ שָׁ֑קֶר וְזֹרֵ֥עַ צְ֝דָקָ֗ה שֶׂ֣כֶר אֱמֶֽת׃

passages.text: Genuine righteousness leads to life, but the pursuit of evil brings death.
passages.sermon:
Righteousness is genuine goodness.
Righteousness leads to life.
Evil is the opposite of righteousness.
A person who pursues evil seeks what is wrong.
The pursuit of evil brings death.
passages.original: כֵּן־ צְדָקָ֥ה לְחַיִּ֑ים וּמְרַדֵּ֖ף רָעָ֣ה לְמוֹתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The perverse in heart are an abomination to the LORD, but the blameless in their walk are His delight.
passages.sermon:
God hates people with twisted hearts.
God finds people with perverse hearts disgusting.
God loves people who live blameless lives.
God delights in those who walk with integrity.
passages.original: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה עִקְּשֵׁי־ לֵ֑ב וּ֝רְצוֹנ֗וֹ תְּמִ֣ימֵי דָֽרֶךְ׃

passages.text: Be assured that the wicked will not go unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will escape.
passages.sermon:
God punishes every wicked person.
No wicked person escapes punishment.
God saves the children of righteous people.
The offspring of the righteous escape harm.
passages.original: יָ֣ד לְ֭יָד לֹא־ יִנָּ֣קֶה רָּ֑ע וְזֶ֖רַע צַדִּיקִ֣ים נִמְלָֽט׃

passages.text: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.
passages.sermon:
A gold ring is valuable and beautiful.
A pig is an unclean animal.
A gold ring in a pig’s snout looks out of place.
A beautiful woman can lack discretion.
A beautiful woman without discretion is like a gold ring in a pig’s snout.
Her beauty does not match her actions.
Her lack of discretion makes her beauty meaningless.
passages.original: נֶ֣זֶם זָ֭הָב בְּאַ֣ף חֲזִ֑יר אִשָּׁ֥ה יָ֝פָ֗ה וְסָ֣רַת טָֽעַם׃

passages.text: The desire of the righteous leads only to good, but the hope of the wicked brings wrath.
passages.sermon:
The righteous person desires good things.
This desire always leads to good.
The wicked person hopes for things.
This hope brings only wrath.
passages.original: תַּאֲוַ֣ת צַדִּיקִ֣ים אַךְ־ ט֑וֹב תִּקְוַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים עֶבְרָֽה׃

passages.text: One gives freely, yet gains even more; another withholds what is right, only to become poor.
passages.sermon:
A generous person gives freely.
This person receives even more in return.
Another person withholds what is right.
This person becomes poor.
passages.original: יֵ֣שׁ מְ֭פַזֵּר וְנוֹסָ֥ף ע֑וֹד וְחוֹשֵׂ֥ךְ מִ֝יֹּ֗שֶׁר אַךְ־ לְמַחְסֽוֹר׃

passages.text: A generous soul will prosper, and he who refreshes others will himself be refreshed.
passages.sermon: A generous person will prosper.\r\nA person who helps others will also receive help.\r\nA person who refreshes others will be refreshed.
passages.original: נֶֽפֶשׁ־ בְּרָכָ֥ה תְדֻשָּׁ֑ן וּ֝מַרְוֶ֗ה גַּם־ ה֥וּא יוֹרֶֽא׃

passages.text: The people will curse the hoarder of grain, but blessing will crown the one who sells it.
passages.sermon:
A person who hoards grain will be cursed by the people.
A person who sells grain will receive blessing.
Blessing will come to the one who provides for others.
People honor those who share what they have.
passages.original: מֹ֣נֵֽעַ בָּ֭ר יִקְּבֻ֣הוּ לְא֑וֹם וּ֝בְרָכָ֗ה לְרֹ֣אשׁ מַשְׁבִּֽיר׃

passages.text: He who searches out good finds favor, but evil will come to him who seeks it.
passages.sermon: A person who searches for good finds favor.\r\nA person who seeks evil receives evil.
passages.original: שֹׁ֣חֵֽר ט֭וֹב יְבַקֵּ֣שׁ רָצ֑וֹן וְדֹרֵ֖שׁ רָעָ֣ה תְבוֹאֶֽנּוּ׃

passages.text: He who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous will thrive like foliage.
passages.sermon:
A person who trusts in his wealth will fall.
He will not stand.
Righteous people will thrive.
They will grow strong like green leaves.
passages.original: בּוֹטֵ֣חַ בְּ֭עָשְׁרוֹ ה֣וּא יִפֹּ֑ל וְ֝כֶעָלֶ֗ה צַדִּיקִ֥ים יִפְרָֽחוּ׃

passages.text: He who brings trouble on his house will inherit the wind, and the fool will be servant to the wise of heart.
passages.sermon:
A person who brings trouble to his own house will gain nothing.
He will inherit only the wind.
A foolish person will become a servant.
He will serve someone who is wise in heart.
passages.original: עוֹכֵ֣ר בֵּ֭יתוֹ יִנְחַל־ ר֑וּחַ וְעֶ֥בֶד אֱ֝וִ֗יל לַחֲכַם־ לֵֽב׃

passages.text: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life, and he who wins souls is wise.
passages.sermon:
A righteous person produces good results.
These good results are like a tree of life.
A wise person wins souls.
Winning souls shows wisdom.
passages.original: פְּֽרִי־ צַ֭דִּיק עֵ֣ץ חַיִּ֑ים וְלֹקֵ֖חַ נְפָשׂ֣וֹת חָכָֽם׃

passages.text: If the righteous receive their due on earth, how much more the ungodly and the sinner!
passages.sermon:
A righteous person lives on earth.
God gives the righteous what they deserve.
God also judges the ungodly.
God also judges the sinner.
If God repays the righteous on earth, He will surely repay the wicked and the sinner.
passages.original: הֵ֣ן צַ֭דִּיק בָּאָ֣רֶץ יְשֻׁלָּ֑ם אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי־ רָשָׁ֥ע וְחוֹטֵֽא׃
